guarantees.claim: When parameter SecMasking is 0, state_out is continuously driven from state_done[0].

assumptions.claim: state_done[0] must contain only the final cipher core output and never carry intermediate round values.
assumptions.risk: Continuous assignment directly exposes unmasked intermediate state on state_out, enabling side-channel leakage.

uncertain_points.claim: The masked branch (gen_state_out_masked) that handles unmasking and PRD forwarding is not provided in this chunk; the actual implementation may fail to prevent leakage as described in the comments.
uncertain_points.risk: An incomplete or flawed masking implementation could leak the final ciphercore output or unmasked intermediate values.
